changelog:
- Initial release of ai-pr-medical-report.
- Upload PDF medical test reports for automatic AI interpretation of key indicators.
- Highlight abnormal results and compare with medical reference ranges.
- Fetch and summarize latest medical literature using brave-search.
- Generate structured and easy-to-understand health reports, with optional visual cards for sharing.
- Supports one-click publishing to social platforms like public accounts or Xiaohongshu.
summary: AI 医学报告解读助手 — 上传检验报告 PDF，AI 自动解读关键指标，查询最新医学文献，生成结构化健康解读报告并支持一键发布。
